description: This PHP file defines the LocalizationAPI class, which provides API endpoints for retrieving and updating localization settings (language and date format) within an admin module of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class implements CRUD endpoint interfaces but only provides implementations for GET and PUT methods, with other methods like create, delete, and getAll throwing not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: LocalizationAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller providing endpoints to retrieve and update localization settings such as language and date format for the admin section of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current localization settings (language and date format).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update localization settings. It updates the default language and date format in the configuration service based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, excluding the 'id' parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update method, validating that provided language and dateFormat are supported values.
